legend: Professor Vector is preparing to teach her Arithmancy class. She needs to prepare n$$$n$$$ distinct magic words for the class. Each magic word is a string consisting of characters X and O. A spell is a string created by concatenating two magic words together. The power of a spell is equal to the number of its different non-empty substrings. For example, the power of the spell XOXO is equal to 7, because it has 7 different substrings: X, O, XO, OX, XOX, OXO and XOXO.

Each student will create their own spell by concatenating two magic words. Since the students are not very good at magic yet, they will choose each of the two words independently and uniformly at random from the n$$$n$$$ words provided by Professor Vector. It is therefore also possible that the two words a student chooses are the same. Each student will then compute the power of their spell, and tell it to Professor Vector. In order to check their work, and of course to impress the students, Professor Vector needs to find out which two magic words and in which order were concatenated by each student.

Your program needs to perform the role of Professor Vector: first, create n$$$n$$$ distinct magic words, and then handle multiple requests where it is given the spell power and needs to determine the indices of the two magic words, in the correct order, that were used to create the corresponding spell.

First, your program should read a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤3$$$1 \le n \le 3$$$), the number of magic words to prepare. Then, it should print n$$$n$$$ magic words it has created, one per line. The magic words must be distinct, each magic word must have at least 1 and at most 30⋅n$$$30\cdot n$$$ characters, and each character must be either X or O. We will denote the i$$$i$$$-th magic word you printed as wi$$$w_i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1 \le i \le n$$$).

Then, your program should read a single integer q$$$q$$$ (1≤q≤1000$$$1 \le q \le 1000$$$), the number of students in the class. Then, it should repeat the following process q$$$q$$$ times, one per student.

For the j$$$j$$$-th student, it should first read a single integer pj$$$p_j$$$, the power of their spell. It is guaranteed that this number is computed by choosing two indices uj$$$u_j$$$ and vj$$$v_j$$$ independently and uniformly at random between 1 and n$$$n$$$ inclusive, concatenating wuj$$$w_{u_j}$$$ and wvj$$$w_{v_j}$$$, and finding the number of different non-empty substrings of the resulting string. Then, your program must print the numbers uj$$$u_j$$$ and vj$$$v_j$$$, in this order (1≤uj,vj≤n$$$1 \le u_j, v_j \le n$$$).
Note that it is not enough to find any two magic words that concatenate into a spell with the given power. You must find the exact words used by the student in the exact order.
Remember to flush the output stream after printing all magic words and after printing uj$$$u_j$$$ and vj$$$v_j$$$ for each student.

legend.ai: Vector 教授正准备教授她的算术占卜课程。她需要为这堂课准备 n$$$n$$$ 个互不相同的魔法单词。每个魔法单词都是一个由字符 X 和 O 组成的字符串。咒语是通过将两个魔法单词拼接在一起得到的字符串。咒语的威力等于其中不同的非空子串的数量。例如，咒语 XOXO 的威力等于 7，因为它有 7 个不同的子串：X、O、XO、OX、XOX、OXO 和 XOXO。

每位学生都会通过拼接两个魔法单词来创造自己的咒语。由于学生们还不太擅长魔法，他们会从 Vector 教授提供的 n$$$n$$$ 个单词中，独立且等概率地随机选择这两个单词。因此，学生选择的两个单词也可能相同。随后，每位学生会计算自己咒语的力量，并将其告知 Vector 教授。为了检查学生的答案，当然也是为了给学生们留下深刻印象，Vector 教授需要找出每位学生拼接了哪两个魔法单词，以及拼接的顺序。
你的程序需要扮演 Vector 教授的角色：首先创建 n$$$n$$$ 个互不相同的魔法单词，然后处理多次请求。每次请求会给出咒语的力量，你需要确定按照正确顺序构成该咒语的两个魔法单词的编号。

首先，你的程序应读入一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤3$$$1 \le n \le 3$$$)，表示需要准备的魔法单词数量。然后，输出它所创建的 n$$$n$$$ 个魔法单词，每行一个。魔法单词必须互不相同，每个魔法单词的长度至少为 1，至多为 30⋅n$$$30\cdot n$$$，且每个字符必须是 X 或 O。我们将你输出的第 i$$$i$$$ 个魔法单词记为 wi$$$w_i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1 \le i \le n$$$)。
接着，你的程序应读入一个整数 q$$$q$$$(1≤q≤1000$$$1 \le q \le 1000$$$)，表示班级中的学生数量。然后，重复以下过程 q$$$q$$$ 次，每位学生执行一次。

对于第 j$$$j$$$ 位学生，首先应读入一个整数 pj$$$p_j$$$，表示其咒语的强度。保证该数的计算方式是：在 1 到 n$$$n$$$(含)之间独立且等概率地随机选择两个下标 uj$$$u_j$$$ 和 vj$$$v_j$$$，将 wuj$$$w_{u_j}$$$ 与 wvj$$$w_{v_j}$$$ 拼接起来，并求所得字符串中不同的非空子串数量。然后，你的程序必须按此顺序输出下标 uj$$$u_j$$$ 和 vj$$$v_j$$$(1≤uj,vj≤n$$$1 \le u_j, v_j \le n$$$)。
注意，找到任意两个拼接后能得到具有给定强度的咒语的魔法单词是不够的。你必须准确找出该学生使用的单词及其顺序。
记得在输出所有魔法单词后，以及为每位学生输出 uj$$$u_j$$$ 和 vj$$$v_j$$$ 后，刷新输出流。
